name: Leather Derby
description: A minimalist leather derby shoe in deep chestnut-brown with open lacing, a clean stitched welt, and a slim vulcanized rubber sole.
materials: smooth full-grain leather upper, stitched leather welt, slim vulcanized rubber sole
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, emblem, or embossed/printed lettering anywhere on the shoe, including the inner sole edge; never add broguing or perforation; never render the leather as matte or heavily textured, it keeps a subtle genuine sheen Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: keep the open derby lacing (quarters stitched on top of the vamp) and the slim low-profile rubber sole exactly as established across every angle; never thicken the sole into a chunky wedge; keep all leather surfaces entirely plain and unmarked When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
